reason: Both identify the identical root cause: the setInterval(...) return value is never assigned to pingTimer, so clearInterval(pingTimer) in ws.onclose is a no-op on undefined. Both describe the same resulting runtime misbehavior: each reconnect calls connect() again, spawning a new interval that also can never be cleared, so ping intervals accumulate/stack indefinitely across reconnects. This is a paraphrase of the same mechanism, not a different bug.
